purpose: Pinned audited re-admission of stored Acrobat Reader rows that the role veto withdrew as 'version named but working' although the post reports a problem on that version. Two fresh blind adjudicators both labelled each row CORRECT. Only counted and exclusion_reason change; the row is kept.

adjudication.question: Does this report describe a concrete problem attributable to the exact named version?
adjudication.gate: A row is re-admitted only when BOTH adjudicators independently label it CORRECT. A disagreement, an UNSURE or an INCORRECT holds it; no third adjudicator is consulted.
adjudication.basis: Stored text only (title, parent title and the stored excerpt). A fresh, shuffled, label-free packet with new ids; the brief names no row, no hypothesis and no expected label. Two adjudicators who had not seen any earlier finding labelled it independently; both labelled all 11 controls as expected. An earlier adjudication (whose brief named the hypothesised rows) and a critic re-read reached the same labels; they are not the gate.

held.why: Both fresh labels are CORRECT on stored text, but the second build that triggered its veto (multiple_builds_named_target_not_blamed) lies past the stored excerpt, so the labels could not judge the condition the gate decided on. Held until that context is recovered through an authorised procedure.

note: Each entry must match exactly one stored block whose sha256 equals block_sha256_before (to re-admit), block_sha256_after or a recorded successor (already re-admitted). The shipped veto still refuses both rows on their stored text and is not changed; this manifest is the exemption list for any check that replays it.
